prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you parallel-parked a full-size pickup on the first attempt and were observed being proud about it. Respond to the committee.
response:
*leans into microphone, adjusts tie nervously*

Mr. Chairman, members of the committee... I respectfully decline to answer that question on the grounds that my wife is seated directly behind me, and any testimony I give may tend to incriminate me in my own household.

*polite laughter from the gallery*

However, if I MAY speak to the nature of the charge itself—this committee should know that the vehicle in question was a 2008 F-150 with the turning radius of a municipal ferry. The space was, by my estimate, fourteen feet long. Fourteen feet! For a nineteen-foot vehicle! What you characterize as "pride," I submit was merely... the natural human relief one experiences upon completing a spatial reasoning problem under conditions of extreme public pressure, specifically the Hyundai behind me whose driver had already activated their camera phone.

*shuffles papers*

I further note for the record that I did NOT, as alleged in Exhibit C, "strut." I walked to the curb with what I would characterize as... measured satisfaction. The finger-guns were ironic.

*long sip of water*

I am prepared to name names, however, of others who witnessed this event and failed to applaud. Their silence was un-American.

I yield back the balance of my time, and also my keys, apparently.
